# The Knot Wedding Planning Website

> The Knot is a one stop shop for all things wedding. Connect with wedding vendors and find guides, inspiration, and easy to use planning tools to make your wedding planning journey effortless.

## Vendor Marketplace

- [Reception Venues](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-reception-venues): Connect with reception venues to host your wedding
- [Wedding Photographers](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-photographers): Find professional film and digital wedding photographers
- [Catering](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/catering): Browse wedding caterers of all different cuisines to match your taste
- [Bridal Salons](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/bridal-salons): Find wedding gowns, bridesmaid dresses, suits, and more at local bridal salons
- [Wedding Planners](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-planners): Connect with professional wedding planners and coordinators to help your big day go off without a hitch
- [Wedding Cakes](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-cake-bakeries): A collection of wedding cake bakers to match any taste
- [Rehearsal Dinners, Bridal Showers & Parties](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/rehearsal-dinners-bridal-showers/): Throw your rehearsal dinner, bridal shower, or other wedding party at one of these unique venues
- [DJs](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-djs): Find local DJs for your reception
- [Videographers](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-videographers): A collection of professional wedding videographers to document your wedding day
- [Wedding Rentals](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-rentals): Browse wedding rental companies for all your furniture, lighting, and dining rental needs, plus more
- [Beauty Services](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/beauty-services): Professional wedding makeup artists and hair stylists for the bride and whole wedding party
- [Florists](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/florists): Pick a florist for all your wedding floral arrangements, centerpieces, and more
- [Wedding Bands](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/live-wedding-bands): Live bands in all genres to play for your wedding reception
- [Officiants & Pre-Marital Counseling](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-officiants): Connect with wedding officiants of all faiths and backgrounds to administer your ceremony
- [Photo Booths](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-photo-booth-rentals): Rent a photo booth for unique souvenirs for you and your guests
- [Transportation](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/transportation-services): Hire a limo, shuttle, trolly, or more to transport you and your guests to the wedding
- [Jewelers](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/jewelers): Finish your wedding ensemble with adornments from a local jeweler
- [Soloists & Ensembles](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-soloists-ensembles): Browse local musicians to play live at your ceremony or reception
- [Dance Lessons](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-dance-lessons): Get dance lessons for any skill level and tear up the floor at your reception
- [Decor](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-decor-shops): Find local shops for all your wedding decor needs
- [Invitations](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/invitations): Connect with wedding invitation vendors
- [Favors & Gifts](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/favors): Say thanks to your guests and wedding party with gifts and favors from these vendors
- [Travel Specialists](https://www.theknot.com/marketplace/wedding-travel-agents): Book your destination wedding or honeymoon with these travel agents
- [Hotel Room Blocks](https://hotelblocks.theknot.com/Wedding-Hotel-Block/?sc=TheKnot_Local): Book hotel blocks for your wedding guests

## Ideas and Advice

- [Getting Engaged Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/getting-engaged-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for planning your planning your engagement from beginning to end from our wedding experts
- [Engagement Ring Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/engagement-ring-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for picking an engagement ring from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Proposal Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/proposal-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for planning your proposal from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Ceremony and Reception Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for your wedding ceremony and reception from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Budgeting Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-budgeting-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for budgeting your wedding from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Invitations and Paper Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/invitations-and-paper-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for wedding invitations and paper products from our wedding experts
- [Style and Theme Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-style-theme-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for picking a wedding style and theme from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Tradition Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-tradition-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for incorporating wedding traditions from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Music Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-music-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for selecting ceremony and reception music from our wedding experts
- [Wedding Rehearsal and Party Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-rehearsal-party-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for planning your wedding parties from our wedding experts
- [Engagement Party Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/engagement-party-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for planning your engagement party from our wedding experts

- [Wedding Registry and Gift Advice](https://www.theknot.com/content/wedding-gift-favor-advice): Find ideas and inspiration for wedding gifts and favors from our wedding experts

- [Gift Guides](https://www.theknot.com/gift-guides): Find gift ideas and inspiration for your significant other from our wedding experts

## Wedding Websites

- [Wedding Websites](https://www.theknot.com/gs/wedding-websites): Learn about The Knot's free wedding website offerings
- [Wedding Website Designs](https://www.theknot.com/gs/wedding-websites/designs): Create a free wedding website in one of hundreds of designs to fit any style

## Planning Tools

- [Wedding Planning Checklist](https://www.theknot.com/wedding-checklist): A free comprehensive wedding checklist customized to your timeline
- [Budget Advisor](https://www.theknot.com/wedding-budget): Create and track your own wedding budget with this free tool
